# SexBasedConnectomeDifferences

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A framework for analyzing how structural and functional brain connectivity patterns differ between sexes, using graph-theoretic and topological measures on connectome data. Provides a biological basis for designing sex-aware neuromorphic architectures and network topologies that better mimic human brain variability in iNEST systems.
